tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List every tracked pharmaceutical product with its annual demand, YoY growth, stock, stockout rate, production CAPA, utilization and ROI.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.title: List regions
tools.description: List the eight Korean SCM regions with their current stock level, risk level and status note.

tools.name: get_region
tools.title: Get region detail
tools.description: Get the stock level, risk level and monitoring note for one SCM region (including the National rollup).

region_id.description: Region id: National, Seoul, Gyeonggi, Gangwon, Chungcheong, Daegu, Honam, Busan or Jeju.

tools.name: get_integration_records
tools.title: Get ERP/MES/WMS records
tools.description: Get the ERP, MES and WMS integration records (document number, sync status, quantity, last sync time, note) for one region and product.

region_id.description: Region id, e.g. Seoul, Gyeonggi, Gangwon, Chungcheong, Daegu, Honam, Busan, Jeju.

product.description: Product name or key, e.g. 리피로우, 타미비어, 세파졸린.
